title: XSS in render_photo_grid: URLs unescaped
description: In fieldwork/src/util.rs render_photo_grid(), post_url and file_url are interpolated directly into HTML href/src attributes via format\!() without escaping. Only alt_text is sanitized via ammonia::clean(). A post_url or file_url containing a double-quote breaks out of the attribute, and a javascript: URI in either enables XSS. These values come from DB rows (media_db), so if any ingestion path (AP federation, API upload) stores a malicious URL, it renders unsanitized. Fix: run post_url and file_url through HTML attribute escaping (e.g., ammonia or html_escape) before interpolation, or build the HTML through ammonia's builder API.
